parameters.name: drain_node
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to drain the nodes that you want to remove. Valid values:

*   true: drain the nodes that you want to remove.
*   false: do not drain the nodes that you want to remove.

parameters.name: instance_ids
parameters.description: A list of instances that you want to remove.

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.description:
This parameter is deprecated.

A list of nodes that you want to remove.

>  This parameter is deprecated. Use instance_ids instead.

parameters.name: release_node
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release the nodes after they are removed. Valid values:

*   true: release the nodes after they are removed.
*   false: do not release the nodes after they are removed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs remove-node-pool-nodes --cluster-id c23421cfa74454bc8b37163fd19af0000 --nodepool-id np97de2cfb1ba042398dd8f5504c940000 --release-node true --drain-node true --nodes cn-hangzhou.172.16.xxx.xxx --instance-ids i-bp1c70fqbv1nlu9xxxxx --concurrency false --region cn-hangzhou
